notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Upgrade Visibility:
[*] Chosen upgrades are now clearly visible.
[*] Displayed on the left side of the screen.
[*] Interface layout optimized for quick reference.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Rarity System:
[*] Upgrades now come in three tiers.
[*] Available rarities: Common, Rare, and Epic.
[*] Rarity determines the chance of appearance.

[*] Value Corrections:
[*] Upgrade values are now displayed accurately.

[*] Wave Enhancements:
[*] Waves now feature more simultaneous shots.

[/list]

[*] Enemies boost health every 2 waves.

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where orbs stopped spawning.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Bleeding upgrade did not unlock its achievement when maxed out.
[*] Fixed the issue where, after completing the game, the upgrades Rain of Lightning, Bats, and Blades continued during the cutscene and after starting a new game.
[*] Fixed the issue with a loud sound playing after finishing the game.
[*] Fixed the issue with the Discord button in the main menu opening multiple tabs simultaneously.

[h3]Thanks to "MerlintheWZRD" for notifying these bugs. Feedback is appreciated for further improvements.[/h3]

notes.title: Skull Update

notes.title: Big Update – “Lightning Rain” Has Arrived!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to introduce a major update featuring our brand-new upgrade, “Lightning Rain”, the star of this patch! In English, it’s called “Storm.” This upgrade unleashes powerful lightning strikes, adding a dramatic flair to your battles.

We’ve also renamed several existing upgrades in English to be shorter and more intuitive:

Haste → Swift
Hemorrhage → Wound
Reaper → Scatter
Grave → Large
Wraith → Velocity
Tomb → Might
Phantom → Bounce
Shard → Fragment
Mend → Heal
Rise → Lift
Drain → Siphon
Specter → Fleet
Luck → Crit
Pallor → Shield
Restore → Cure
(Upgrades Volley, Swarm, and Vital kept their English names.)

We hope you enjoy the clearer names and the thrilling new “Lightning Rain” upgrade. Thanks for playing and for your continued support!

[*] New boss "[b]Grave Deceiver[/b]" added to the game. [b](Wave 100)[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]

[*] Bullets lose damage when colliding with other bullets.
[*] Bullets lose damage when fragmenting.
[*] Initial enemy health has been adjusted.
[*] Enemy health increase per wave has been modified.
[*] Player's initial health has been adjusted.
[*] Player health increase per wave has been altered.
[/list]
[h2]Upgrade Changes[/h2]

[h3]Burst:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Only the middle bullet deals full damage.
[*] The side bullets deal half damage.
[/list]
[h3]Throwing Blades:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Lose damage based on the maximum number of upgrades acquired.
[*] The more Throwing Blades upgrades, the lower the damage of each blade.
[/list]
[h3]Fragmentation:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Lose damage based on the maximum number of upgrades acquired.
[*] The more Fragmentation upgrades, the lower the damage of each fragment.
[/list]
[h3]Bat Horde:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Lose damage based on the maximum number of upgrades acquired.
[*] The more Bat Horde upgrades, the lower the damage of each bat.
[/list]
